description: pac copilot pull: three-way merge of server changes into the local workspace (also downloads knowledge files). Run before editing and before pushing. Records a sync stamp (.mcs/cs-sync.json) so cs_check_drift can tell later portal changes from yours; commit the workspace afterwards to keep a reviewable history.

workspace.description: Path to (or inside) the agent workspace. Defaults to CPS_WORKSPACE or the current directory.

name: cs_pull
title: Pull remote changes
